candidates.computation_change_reason: Scopes the following monitoring and reporting provisions to major dischargers. 1. The permittee shall effectively monitor the operation and efficiency of all treatment and

candidates.computation_change_reason: Imposes a general obligation to monitor treatment performance and discharge quantity/quality.
